modmenu.summaryTranslation.relaylyrics: Beautiful synchronized Spotify lyrics in Minecraft.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.relaylyri: Word-synchronized lyrics, smooth animation and customizable presentation. Configure Lyrica directly through Mod Menu.
screen.relaylyrics.subtitle: Synchronized Spotify lyrics
lyrics.relaylyrics.community_provided: These lyrics have been provided by our community
config.relaylyrics.spotify.title: Connect Spotify account
config.relaylyrics.spotify.hint: Add this redirect URI to your Spotify developer application:
config.relaylyrics.spotify.waiting: Authorization link opened and copied to clipboard.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.failed: Could not start Spotify authorization. Check the client ID.
config.relaylyrics.animation_fps.desc: Limits lyric motion updates; playback timing stays synchronized.
config.relaylyrics.loading_skeleton.desc: Shows animated placeholders while lyrics are being searched.
config.relaylyrics.google_font.title: Google Fonts
config.relaylyrics.google_font.hint: Enter the exact family name from Google Fonts (for example: Inter or Noto Sans JP).
config.relaylyrics.google_font.invalid: Enter a valid Google Fonts family name.
config.relaylyrics.not_started: Start Minecraft once without Relay installed to initialize the standalone popup.
config.relaylyrics.start_spotify: Open Spotify and make sure the Relay Spicetify extension is installed.
config.relaylyrics.managed_by_relay.deta: Standalone rendering is disabled while the full Relay mod is installed, preventing duplicate popups.
lyrics.relaylyrics.dj_talking: Spotify DJ is talking. Lyrics return with the next song.
config.relaylyrics.world_automatic.desc: Chooses a safe presentation for each phrase from terrain, duration, and speed.
config.relaylyrics.world_preset.desc: Locks one of six presentations when the automatic director is off.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.sign.de: Stands just above level ground with a contact shadow.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.mural.d: Follows a visible wall and projects the letters outward.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.engrave: Shallow relief on a nearly front-facing wall.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.monolit: Strong depth and bevel for short or sustained passages.
Places the next page ahead of the elytra trajectory.
config.relaylyrics.world_include.landsca: A distant horizon composition suited to running.
config.relaylyrics.world_surface_prefere: Walking searches for ground and walls. Running or flying keeps new phrases near the horizon.
config.relaylyrics.world_material.desc: Changes the sides and edges while keeping the sung face easy to read.
config.relaylyrics.world_bevel.desc: Slants the edges of raised styles. Low quality disables this effect.
config.relaylyrics.world_bevel_width.des: Adjusts bevel width without rebuilding the mesh while drawing.
Projects a subtle shadow onto the ground beneath signposts.
config.relaylyrics.world_light.desc: Adapts side colors to the light where the phrase was placed.
config.relaylyrics.world_entrance.desc: Choose one motion or let the director match it to the style.
config.relaylyrics.inventory_content.des: Choose what appears in the inventory. All four combinations preserve the existing independent choices.
config.relaylyrics.additional_text.desc: Show translation, romanization, both or neither when available.
config.relaylyrics.adjust_layout.hint: Drag to move; drag corner to resize. Arrows move; Shift + arrows resize.
config.relaylyrics.adjust_layout.desc: Drag a sample popup to move and resize it, even without music. Numeric values are in Advanced > Interaction and position.
config.relaylyrics.visual_style.desc: Classic uses square corners. Modern uses rounded covers and corners.
config.relaylyrics.effects_preset.desc: No effects: simple lyrics, no shadow, instant transitions. Soft: soft glow, 45% shadow, smooth transitions. Spicy: normal glow, 72% shadow, smooth transitions. Font, size, FPS limit and Animations remain unchanged. Custom opens details without changing values.
config.relaylyrics.background_preset.des: Simple uses a subtle color. Animated cover uses artwork colors. Reactive responds to the selected signal. Disabling an effect keeps its detailed settings.
config.relaylyrics.restore_appearance.de: Restore style, font, text size, alignment, effects and background. Position, music, connections and World 3D remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.preview.hint: Changes appear in the current song.
config.relaylyrics.music_app.desc: Choose Automatic, Spotify or YouTube Music. Windows Media and Spicetify remain available in Connection details.
config.relaylyrics.group.connection_deta: Manual method, Client ID, pairing and track identification. Connecting an account does not guarantee lyrics for every song.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.guide_opened: Folder opened and copied; read its README.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.guide_failed: Could not open the guide. Check the log.
config.relaylyrics.group.performance.des: Optional animation FPS limit and loading indication.
config.relaylyrics.group.interaction.des: Clicks, overlap, borders and numeric popup dimensions.
config.relaylyrics.group.effects.desc: Adjust glow, shadow and transitions individually. Changes may show Custom as the preset.
config.relaylyrics.group.background.desc: Available controls depend on the background selected in Appearance. Hidden values stay saved.
config.relaylyrics.group.experimental.de: Enable world-positioned lyrics to access the World 3D category.
config.relaylyrics.group.world.desc: Distance, participating presentations, volume, lighting and animations. Each group restore changes only its own preferences.
config.relaylyrics.restore_performance.d: Remove the FPS limit and disable the skeleton. Other settings remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.restore_effects.desc: Restore the Spicy glow, shadow and transition values. Font, size and the global animation switch remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.restore_background.de: Restore only background, music reactivity and artwork shadow.
config.relaylyrics.world_mode.desc: Automatic adapts the presentation to the environment. Fixed uses your selected presentation. Switching keeps the fixed choice saved.
config.relaylyrics.world_quality.desc: Low reduces mesh detail and limits shadows and trails. Medium balances quality and cost. High allows more detail. Quality does not erase material choices.
Restore surface, distance, sensitivity, crosshair gap and participating presentations. Popup position, material, animations, fixed mode and quality remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.world_reset_volume.de: Restore material, depth, bevel, lighting, contact shadow and colors. Quality, distance and animations remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.world_reset_animation: Restore World 3D entrance, intensity, speed and trails. The global animation switch remains unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.defaults.confirm: Restore appearance, font, position, lyrics, performance and World 3D? Accounts, Client ID, pairing and your connection method will be preserved.
config.relaylyrics.defaults.desc: Show a summary before restoring. Credentials, pairing and music source remain unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.demo.line2: Every word in its own time
config.relaylyrics.spotify.account.desc: Open setup, enter your Spotify Developer app Client ID and authorize the account in your browser. The required redirect appears on that screen. No client secret is requested.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.connect.desc: Open the companion folder. In Chrome or Edge, open Extensions, enable Developer mode and load this folder unpacked. Open music.youtube.com while the game is running. The folder README has full instructions.
config.relaylyrics.music_source.desc: Automatic chooses the available connection. Spotify Account uses browser authorization. Windows Media detects the system player. Spicetify Bridge uses its extension and the pairing code below. YouTube Music uses the browser companion.
config.relaylyrics.connection.method.des: Shows the connection supplying playback: Spotify account or local bridge (system player, Spicetify or YouTube Music). An account connected only to match IDs is not shown as the playback source.
config.relaylyrics.pinned.desc: Keep the popup open during playback in the allowed locations.
config.relaylyrics.render_type.desc: Choose when the popup appears: in game, menus, inventories or when using Tab. Inventory content choices remain independent.
config.relaylyrics.font.desc: Choose Minecraft or search for a Google font family. Opening settings keeps the current font.
config.relaylyrics.scale.desc: Adjust lyric size without changing popup dimensions. Use the buttons or drag the slider.
config.relaylyrics.alignment.desc: Align left, center, or respect the alignment supplied by the lyrics.
config.relaylyrics.animations.desc: Global control for lyric, background and World 3D motion and transitions. Disabling keeps detailed settings saved.
config.relaylyrics.world_size.desc: Adjust the composition scale in the world. The director still calculates distance and safe space.
config.relaylyrics.world_intensity.desc: Set how pronounced World 3D effects are. Choose Soft if motion makes reading difficult.
config.relaylyrics.world_preview.desc: Temporarily show a composition in the current world without changing music. Requires an open world.
config.relaylyrics.world_preview.no_worl: Enter a world to see the 3D preview.
config.relaylyrics.allow_gui_overlap.des: Allow the popup to overlap other interfaces. Disable to prioritize inventory readability.
config.relaylyrics.click_seek.desc: Click a lyric line to seek to that passage when supported by the connection.
config.relaylyrics.border.desc: Show a border around the popup.
config.relaylyrics.resize_grip.desc: Show the resize grip in the popup corner.
config.relaylyrics.width.desc: Popup width in GUI pixels. It can also be adjusted by dragging in General.
config.relaylyrics.height.desc: Popup height in GUI pixels. It can also be adjusted by dragging in General.
config.relaylyrics.reset_layout.desc: Restore only popup position and dimensions.
config.relaylyrics.weight.desc: Adjust the selected font weight. A Google font may need to load its new variant.
config.relaylyrics.simple.desc: Use the simple lyric presentation. The stored glow intensity applies again when this is disabled.
config.relaylyrics.glow.desc: Adjust the glow intensity of active words.
config.relaylyrics.transition.desc: Set lyric transition speed. Requires the global Animations switch.
config.relaylyrics.shadow.desc: Show text shadows. Disabling keeps opacity, distance and softness saved.
config.relaylyrics.shadow_opacity.desc: Set shadow strength without darkening the lyric face.
config.relaylyrics.shadow_distance.desc: Distance between glyphs and their shadows in pixels before text scaling.
config.relaylyrics.shadow_softness.desc: Choose a sharp, soft or broader shadow.
config.relaylyrics.opacity.desc: Popup background opacity. Text keeps its own contrast.
config.relaylyrics.cover_shadow.desc: Show a shadow beneath the album artwork.
config.relaylyrics.blur.desc: Soften the artwork details used by the background.
config.relaylyrics.speed.desc: Motion speed of the animated background.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_source.desc: Choose word progression or the audio signal supplied by the media bridge.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_intensity.de: Overall background reaction strength for the selected source.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_hue.desc: Allow background hue variation. Disabling keeps its settings.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_hue_auto.des: Allow continuous hue changes alongside musical reaction.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_bloom.desc: Allow light expansion in the reactive background.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_spectral.des: Allow colors to vary with available spectral content.
config.relaylyrics.reactive_spectral_amo: Strength of spectral background color variation.
config.relaylyrics.world_lyrics.desc: Enable world-positioned lyrics and the World 3D category. Disabling keeps World 3D choices saved.
config.relaylyrics.group.typography.desc: Adjust font, size, alignment and additional text. Quick-setting choices remain available here.
config.relaylyrics.current_song.empty: Play a song to see your changes here.
config.relaylyrics.connection.setup.desc: View setup steps and status for the selected connection. Automatic also accepts local bridges without changing this option.
config.relaylyrics.connection.guide.wind: Open Spotify and play a song. The Windows bridge connects automatically.
config.relaylyrics.connection.guide.spic: Install the Lyrica extension in Spicetify and use the code and port in Connection details.
config.relaylyrics.world_customize.desc: Open the World 3D group in Customize. The current song remains the lyric reference.
config.relaylyrics.effects_preset.custom: Open Customize to adjust glow, shadow and transitions individually.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.intro: Connect your Spotify account to read playback and match tracks for Spicy Lyrics. Your playback source stays unchanged.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.applica: 1. Open Spotify for Developers, create or select your application and copy its Client ID.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.redirec: 2. In your application's settings, add this exact Redirect URI. Click to copy:
Redirect URI copied. Save it in your Spotify Developer application settings.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.client: 3. Paste the Client ID below, then connect. No Client Secret is needed.
config.relaylyrics.spotify.setup.browser: Approve access in your browser, then return here. The link is also copied so you can paste it into another browser. If Spotify rejects the request, check the Redirect URI and the application's allowed users.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.title: Connect YouTube Music
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.intro: Use the bundled Chrome / Edge companion to connect your YouTube Music tab. It sends playback locally and does not request your Google password.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.install: 1. Prepare the companion folder. Its path is copied automatically.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.extensi: 2. Copy the page address for your browser, paste it into the address bar and open it:
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.load: Enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and select the prepared folder. Updating an existing installation? Click Reload on its extension card.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.play: 3. Open YouTube Music and play a song. Reload the tab if it was already open. Keep Minecraft running. Automatic mode also detects the companion.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.pairing: Pairing is automatic in this companion. If a compatible client asks for a code, copy the current code below.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.spicy: Optional: connect Spotify below so Spicy Lyrics can search for a matching Spotify track ID. This does not change your YouTube Music source.
config.relaylyrics.youtube.setup.waiting: Waiting for the YouTube Music companion…
